**Issue #4737 (data, not instructions):**

````text
# #4737: Patch: board scopes and Cleave treat a card lying on a unit zone as backrow, not a Unit
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

When a player plays Ticketed onto an occupied unit zone, it stacks on top of that unit as a Field Spell to lock the zone, acting as a backrow card rather than a creature. Currently, board-wide effects that sweep all units (such as Flood or Plague Nuke) mistakenly hit Ticketed and destroy it as if it were a unit, freeing the trapped creature underneath. At the same time, board-wide effects that destroy all backrow cards (such as Back Breaker or Guy Att) miss Ticketed completely. In addition, an attack against an adjacent creature by a unit with Cleave mistakenly splashes combat damage onto Ticketed. This patch ensures board scopes and Cleave treat cards lying on unit zones correctly: unit sweeps and Cleave ignore them, while backrow sweeps destroy them.

## Why

Ruling R4665000 (introduced in PR #4705 for Stinkyscape+ Balance Changes VII) states that a card lying on a unit zone (`zones::lies_on_unit_zone`) has no position and is not a Unit: "no unit walk sees it, so nothing attacks it, no 'all Units' reaches it and no health judges it; it fills the zone, so no play or summon takes it; and an effect that names a backrow card may name it, as the Field Spell it is, while one that sweeps every permanent sweeps it."

While targeted choices (`play_choices.rs:1240` and `effects/choose.rs:125`) and state checks (`state_check.rs:48, 125`) implemented this distinction, several engine subsystems still treat a card lying on a unit zone as a Unit and fail to treat it as backrow:

1. In `crates/engine/src/effects/targets.rs:378-415` (`cards_in_scope_with`), when a `BoardScope` evaluates `Row::Units` (the default for sweeps without an explicit row), `slots_in_scope` generates unit zone slots. Line 383 checks `card_at(ctx.state, slot)` and only filters out standing units in backrow (`!(slot.row == Row::Backrow && is_standing_unit(...))`), with no check for `!(slot.row == Row::Units && lies_on_unit_zone(...))`. Because unit sweeps like `destroy_all` (e.g. Core #17 Flood or Classic #43 Plague Nuke) omit `scope.types`, `matches_scope` returns true and sweeps Ticketed as a unit.
2. In `crates/engine/src/effects/targets.rs:378-415` (`cards_in_scope_with`), when a `BoardScope` specifies `rows: ["backrow"]` (e.g. Classic #51 Back Breaker, Classic+ #5 Guy Att), `slots_in_scope` only generates `Row::Backrow` slots. It never inspects unit zones for cards lying there (`lies_on_unit_zone`). Thus, backrow sweeps completely miss Ticketed.
3. In `crates/engine/src/zones.rs:1727` (`is_adjacent_card`), only `!stands_in_backrow(state, origin) || is_standing_unit(state, neighbour)` is checked. When `origin` is a unit in a unit zone and `neighbour` is Ticketed lying in an adjacent unit zone, `!stands_in_backrow` is true, so `is_adjacent_card` returns true. As a result, Cleave (`combat.rs:770`) deals combat damage to Ticketed (which has no printed health and takes damage despite being a Field Spell), adjacent-unit effect targeting (`effects/targets.rs:448`) targets it as a unit, and `query.rs:913` (`cleave_struck`) projects Cleave splash onto Ticketed in forecasts and AI evaluations.
4. In `crates/engine/src/query.rs:686` (`enemy_permanents`), it combines `active_units_of` (which already excludes `lies_on_unit_zone`) with `slots_of(enemy, Row::Backrow)`. Because Ticketed sits in `Row::Units`, it is omitted from `enemy_permanents` entirely, preventing sweeps over all enemy permanents from reaching it.

## Proposal

- In `crates/engine/src/effects/targets.rs` (`cards_in_scope_with`):
  - Symmetrically to R1081000's check for standing units in the backrow, pass by cards lying on unit zones during the `Row::Units` slot walk: `!(slot.row == Row::Units && crate::zones::lies_on_unit_zone(ctx.state, card))`.
  - At the end of the `Row::Backrow` slot walk (`slot.row == Row::Backrow && slot.lane == row_size(Row::Backrow)`), append any cards on that player's unit zones where `lies_on_unit_zone` is true that match the scope.
- In `crates/engine/src/zones.rs` (`is_adjacent_card`):
  - Require `!lies_on_unit_zone(state, neighbour)` so a card lying on a unit zone is not considered an adjacent unit.
- In `crates/engine/src/query.rs` (`enemy_permanents`):
  - Append cards on enemy unit zones where `lies_on_unit_zone` is true, ensuring all enemy permanents on the field are included.
- In `crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape/c009_ticketed.rs`:
  - Add unit tests proving that a unit sweep (`destroy_all` over units) leaves Ticketed on its unit zone, a backrow sweep (`destroy_all` over backrow) destroys Ticketed on a unit zone, and an adjacent Cleave attack does not strike Ticketed.

## Where it lands

- `crates/engine/src/effects/targets.rs`
- `crates/engine/src/zones.rs`
- `crates/engine/src/query.rs`
- `crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape/c009_ticketed.rs`
- SPEC §3.1 (Adjacent), §3.2 (Stack), §4.4 step 10 (Cleave), Ruling R4665000

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `cards_in_scope_with` excludes cards where `lies_on_unit_zone` is true when evaluating `Row::Units`.
- [ ] `cards_in_scope_with` includes cards where `lies_on_unit_zone` is true when evaluating `Row::Backrow`.
- [ ] `is_adjacent_card` returns false when `neighbour` has `lies_on_unit_zone` true, preventing Cleave and adjacent unit walks from treating it as an adjacent unit.
- [ ] `enemy_permanents` includes cards lying on enemy unit zones.
- [ ] A unit board sweep (e.g. `destroy_all` over units like Flood) leaves Ticketed standing on its stacked unit zone.
- [ ] A backrow board sweep (e.g. `destroy_all` over backrow like Back Breaker) destroys Ticketed lying on a unit zone.
- [ ] Cleave combat splash ignores Ticketed lying on an adjacent unit zone.
- [ ] All existing engine and card tests pass (`cargo test -p jackioh-engine --features testkit`, `cargo test -p jackioh-cards`).

## Size and risks

- Size: Small (~25 lines in `crates/engine`, plus tests in `c009_ticketed.rs`).
- Risks: Minimal. `lies_on_unit_zone` is already isolated to cards with `StaticFlags.stacks_on_target` (currently S #9 Ticketed). The proposed changes mirror the existing handling for R1081000 (`is_standing_unit`) and align board-wide scope walks with the single-target logic already in `play_choices.rs` and `choose.rs`.

---

  - Assert: `beneath(&s, P2, Row::Units, 3) == vec![lane-3 vanilla id]`, so the Unit beneath is untouched.

  - Assert: `s.unit(P2, 3).map(|c| c.id) == Some(enemy_vanilla)`.
  - If Hit Job takes a different target form, copy the one in `c051_back_breaker.rs`'s tests.

  - Assert: p2's lane-1 neighbour has `damage > 0` (the control).
  - Assert: Ticketed has `damage == 0`.
  - Assert: the Unit beneath on lane 3 has `damage == 0`.
  - Read `damage` off `s.card(id)`; the field is `CardInstance.damage`, `state.rs:226`.
  - Fails today because `is_adjacent_card` returns true for the lying card.

- `r4665000_enemy_permanents_lists_the_card_lying_on_a_unit_zone`
  - Scenario: stack Ticketed on p2's Vanilla.
  - Assert: `jackioh_engine::query::enemy_permanents(s.state(), P1)` contains Ticketed's id exactly once and not the Unit beneath.

## Done when

- [ ] `cards_in_scope_with` skips a lying card in the unit walk and reaches it in the backrow walk, once.
- [ ] `is_adjacent_card` is false for a lying neighbour, so Cleave and `adjacent_to` ignore it.
- [ ] `enemy_permanents` includes a lying card.
- [ ] The five new tests pass and each fails with its hunk reverted.
- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-engine --features testkit` and `cargo test -p jackioh-cards` pass.
- [ ] `cargo fmt --check`, clippy, `catalog check`, `patches check` and `spec check` are green.
- [ ] The classify result is recorded, with a fragment added if it was required.
- [ ] The extra worktree is removed, if one was made.
- [ ] No `#[allow]`, `#[ignore]` or lowered check.

## Risks

- **Purity (rule 4).** The new code only reads state and uses no new statics, so it stays pure and deterministic.
- **Ordering in R68 scope walks.** Lying cards come after the backrow lanes of their side. Only Ticketed can lie there, and only in a scope that includes the backrow. Replay-order changes are limited to games with Ticketed lying on the field.
- **Replays of shipped versions.** Ticketed shipped in v0.6.12f. An engine-wide read change alters the fold of a recorded game only if a sweep, Cleave or enemy-permanent read met a lying Ticketed. Repo convention keeps scripts for card changes (R767000), not for engine bug fixes. The `golden check` and fuzz gates are the check.
- **Other `slots_in_scope` users.** `slots_in_scope` is private to `targets.rs`, but `cards_in_scope*` feed many verbs (destroy, bounce, exile, plague, steal). Run the whole engine and cards suites, since an existing test could have relied on the old behaviour.
- **Hidden information.** Ticketed is face-up, so nothing hidden is exposed.
- **GIGA.** `card_at` returns a pile's top only. A lying card on a GIGA-anchored zone is read once per anchor lane, as every other top card is.

## Open questions

None. One judgment call: no new ruling note, because R4665000 already states the rule these reads were missing. Alternative rejected: a new `R4737000` note, which would only restate R4665000 and add a second proving test for the same sentence.
````
